verdict.rationale: Yapily documents an OpenAPI v3 specification covering its API, which gives programmatic consumers documented schemas. It also documents account, balance and transaction retrieval endpoints and claims transaction categorisation with merchant detection, so the core of the story is present. Probes of common OpenAPI paths returned 404, but the docs say the spec is provided, so this does not contradict it; it only means the spec could not be confirmed at a well-known machine-readable URL. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that responses are clean structured JSON, published field-level schemas for enrichment output (categories and merchant fields), a confirmed fetchable OpenAPI URL, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the data is consumable without heuristic parsing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the data comes back agent-consumable — clean structured JSON, documented schemas, and enrichment an automated financial workflow can reason over without heuristic parsing
